claim: CLFDES sets FIVE shakes: LDA #5 / STA PFRAME,U "number of shakes to do" (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4563).
The shake counter is PFRAME,U, decremented per shake (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4564).

source.verbatim: STA	PFRAME,U	number of shakes to do

claim: Each shake holds PCNAP 10 after the first BCKYUP jerk (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4567).
A shaking cliff is tinted by altering its DMA flavor to $2A: LDA #$2A (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4570).

source.verbatim: LDA	#$2A		by altering the cliffs flavor

claim: Each shake holds a SECOND PCNAP 10 after the flavor write — 20 naps per shake (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4572).
After the shakes, JSR LOCCLR erases the cliff image to replace it with debris (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4575).

source.verbatim: JSR	LOCCLR		go erase the image as we will replace with

claim: A PCNAP 2 erase blip separates the shake and debris phases (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4576).
The debris phase draws FIVE images: LDA #5 "where there are five images" (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4579).

source.verbatim: LDA	#5		where there are five images

claim: Each debris frame is held PCNAP 8 "while we sleep a little" (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4594).

source.verbatim: PCNAP	8		while we sleep a little

claim: CLFDES ends by suiciding the process: JMP VSUCIDE — the cliff is now gone (JOUSTRV4.SRC:4599).
